name: SageBot personality, answer policy, refusal style, and command UX consistency
scope: Prompt version registry for answer, daily signal, quiz, challenge, and weekly recap paths
Tone and policy scoring for public generated content paths
Admin/debug prompt version toggle for ask-sage responses

implemented.result: Added shared personality prompt builders, prompt version registry, refusal/insufficient-context policy, and deterministic policy scoring.
Replaced rag_answer_v1 with sagebot_answer_v2 and included personality version in answer generation, observability metadata, retrieval logs, persisted answers, and eval runs.
Daily Signal drafts now use sagebot_daily_signal_v2, shared policy prompt, policy scoring, and DeepSeek-first/provider-disciplined wording.
Quiz and challenge drafts now store separate sagebot_quiz_generator_v2 and sagebot_challenge_generator_v2 prompt versions with policy scores and metadata.
Weekly recap drafts now use sagebot_weekly_recap_v2 and store the shared policy score and policy metadata.
Ask-sage has an admin/debug prompt version toggle via DISCORD_SHOW_PROMPT_VERSION=true, and premium answer requests persist prompt/personality metadata.

verification.evidence: next build exited 0; dynamic server usage warnings were emitted for existing academy cookie-backed pages but build completed successfully.

knownGapsAfterPhase: Full RAG eval still has 5 failing golden questions, mostly retrieval/source misses. This is improved from Phase 3's 44/50 to 45/50 but not yet 95%+.
The admin prompt-version toggle is environment-based, not yet a clickable admin UI setting.
Policy scoring is stored on generated draft paths, but hard blocking of low-scoring drafts is still a future quality-gate hardening step.
